summary: Verified responsive overflow fixes for Fix-the-Slop static site. Tested index.html, blog.html, admin.html at 320px & 375px, and all five pages (index/admin/blog/contact/tools) at 768px & 1440px. Zero horizontal overflow detected (scrollWidth == clientWidth on every combo). Admin demo login at 320px also renders without overflow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three overflow issues from iteration 1 (hero orb, blog pager, stat card) are resolved. 17/17 viewport/page combinations show diff=0 between scrollWidth and clientWidth. No further responsive testing required.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1 overflows were caused by rigid grid track sizes (1fr) and fixed hero orb width. Fixes using minmax(0,1fr) on .stats and .grid-3, min(720px,100%) on .hero-orb, flex-wrap on .pagination, and reduced container padding at <=400px correctly eliminated horizontal scroll on all tested viewports.
